secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google Gemini API key for AI features (assistant, career roadmap, skill matcher, profile assistant). Optional — AI features fall back to mock responses without it. Get it from https://aistudio.google.com/apikey

secrets.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Stripe secret key for payment processing. Optional — uses a mock key without it. Get it from https://dashboard.stripe.com/apikeys
